title: Cross-Survey Parameter Transfer Validation of Energy-Flow Cosmology: DESI DR2 Parameters Applied to BOSS/eBOSS BAO Without Refitting
abstract: Post-hoc cross-survey validation of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) by transferring parameters calibrated on DESI DR2 BAO to independent BOSS/eBOSS BAO data without refitting. The study finds a robust chi-square improvement on BOSS DR12 (Δχ² = −7.77, k_eff = 0) that persists under whitening, eigenmode, and covariance-robustness diagnostics, supporting parameter stability across surveys without claiming a detection.
